description: List Patch's open fix pull requests from your yof.io account, with the state of each one's CI checks. Use it to see whether a fix Patch proposed is waiting, passing or failing; use yof_lessons for fixes already merged, and yof_findings for problems with no pull request yet. Needs YOF_API_KEY; sends only app_id to yof.io, which answers from what it last stored (up to 50, newest first) without asking GitHub again. Returns open (repository, number, url, draft, rule, title, checks, failed_checks, opened) and a note; an empty list means Patch has no open pull request.

app_id.description: One app's id, to list only that app's pull requests. Default: every app in the account.

name: yof_patch_status

note.description: Reminder that this tool changes nothing.

checks.description: CI state as yof last stored it.

failed_checks.description: Names of failed checks, at most 20.

rule.description: The rule the fix is for.

title: Patch pull requests
